description: ES4 (ADR 1.10.26af D7): widgetSnippet(options) for every server kit. `options` uses the camelCase option names; a kit with snake_case options maps them in its test. `expect.html` is the exact output (three lines, no trailing newline), with {{version}} replaced by the kit's VERSION; `expect.refused` names the first refused option, in the order planId, surface, theme, locale, lingaraOrigin, title, id, tokenEndpoint, nonce, elementSrc.

cases.name: defaults

expect.html:
<lingara-embed id="lingara-embed" surface="practice" plan-id="7d0c2b1e-4f3a-4c8e-9b21-5e6f7a8b9c0d"></lingara-embed>
<script type="module" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@lingara/embed@{{version}}/dist/lingara-embed.min.js"></script>
<script type="module">document.getElementById("lingara-embed").tokenProvider = async () => (await fetch("/lingara/token", { method: "POST", credentials: "same-origin" })).json();</script>
